This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with three bidders and values i.i.d. uniform 0-49. In a Vickrey auction, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ bids, because price paid equals the second-highest bid. With value $35, I should bid 35 to win whenever the top competing bid is below 35 and avoid overpaying if others exceed 35. No history to exploit in 1 round.
